en: Beyond that...
W-Well, you're a really good guy.

You've got money and power, too.
That's it! Yer the perfect man!

You're the only guy
I could ever think of as my dad.
I adore Hiroshima.
I adore its natural beauty.

Furthermore, I adore the honest,
hardworking people of this town.

Iwami Shipbuilding has
really grown over time.

I've gained more wealth than
most people can imagine.

However, riches pale in comparison
to the livelihoods we give those people.
That is where the true joy in life lies.
And the Yomei Alliance is no different.
Even kids like you need work.

Hiroshima could only benefit by taking you
off the street and into my organization.

You're right.
I'll never forget what I owe you.

...Both Iwami Shipbuilding and the Yomei Alliance
may soon meet their end.
Huh!? Wh-Why's that?
Tell me why!
There is a great secret hidden in Onomichi.

If it were revealed, it would be
the end of both of my businesses.
It would be the end of me as well.

I-I don't get it!
What's this big secret?
That, I cannot say.
Huh? B-But...
Oh. I think I understand.
Someone's blackmailin' you.
Using that secret t'get leverage over you, huh?

Screw that!
Y'don't gotta worry, though!
I'll take out every last one of 'em!

Tell me, who's blackmailing you?
Where can I find 'em!?
You are mistaken.

This isn't a problem a few
deaths will solve, Hirose.
Huh? Then...
...What can we do?
Boss! I'll do whatever it takes!

Jus' tell me how to fix it!
C'mon, Boss!

I know this may not make much sense,
but I have a request to make of you.
It involves the secret of Onomichi.

The thing that could bring down
Iwami Shipbuilding and the Yomei Alliance.

And the thing that could rock
the very foundation of Hiroshima.
I'd like you to protect it with me.
A secret...
You want me to protect?
You will never learn the secret itself...

...But you will need to risk your life
to guarantee its safety all the same.
Until your dying breath.

I'll never know what it is,
for the rest of my life...?
Th-That's, uh...

I understand. Protecting an unknown secret
is quite difficult. Perhaps impossible.
N-Not at all!
I can do it.
Very well.

I hope that remains true once
you see the commitment I expect.

As I demand a great deal from you,
I want to show how invested I am as well.
It is only fair.
Don't worry, B-Boss.
I can keep whatever secret y'have.
It's me.
Yes. As soon as possible.
Hm? Oh, it's you, Hirose.
Boss. You called for me?
Why!? Why'd y'do that!?
I needed to prove a point.
You saw it, right?
And now?
Will you sell me out to the police?

Or can you commit to taking
this secret to your grave?
Compared to the secret of Onomichi, this...
This means nothing at all!
I will do <font_kind=yakuza_italic>anything</font_kind> to protect it.
I would discard my humanity if need be!
Now please.
You see what it will take.

This town, this company<symbol=em_dash_with_outline> No,
Hiroshima requires our protection.

If you're trying to reach Daidoji-sensei,
I'm afraid he won't be answering.
There's no point asking for help now.
How long have you been here?

The secret is out in the open.
You're finished.
But things are looking up for me.

Thanks to you,
Daidoji and I have formed a new contract.
The secret of Onomichi is my responsibility now.

Along with all the influence Daidoji
brings to the table. His money, too.
Stop this.
You cannot handle the pressure.
You should have believed in your son...

My father, Takeru Kurusu,
has committed suicide in Hiroshima.

The matter of the battleship
in Hiroshima is taken care of.
Nobody will be able to trace it to you.
Therefore, I have a request.
You and my late father had an arrangement.
I anticipate the same.
Excuse the intrusion.
The one who exposed the ship.
Kazuma Kiryu. Dispose of him.
My time runs short.
But if you take care of this before my passing...
...You too may earn the name Takeru Kurusu.
I understand.
Apparently Hirose-san's gone now.
But... I won't give up on you.
I need you to get up.
Date-san! Hey, wake up!
It's Haruka! Haruka's<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>

Go get the doctor!
Hurry!
I should probly step out for a bit.
No, it's okay.
I want you to be here.
I thought when you woke up...
...The first thing I'd do was lecture you.
I can't believe you just disappeared like that.
The kids and I were worried to death.
I had a lot I wanted to say to you.
But now...
Now that I see your face alive and well...
...I can't find the words to say.
Uncle Kaz.
I'm so sorry.
Hi there.
You're the fourth chairman, yes?
What business do you have here today?
I need to talk to Sugai.
I can show myself up.
Get out of my way!
You look well, Kiryu.
Hellooo!
What's going on here?
That should be clear, Fourth Chairman.
Someya will be your opponent today.
I'm told...

...You were planning to kill both
myself and President Iwami, yes?
Well, once you're gone...

...I will find Haruka Sawamura and her
child and make sure they're next.
It doesn't matter if Daidoji dies before then.
This is what happens when you cross us.
Your deaths will be a warning to the world.
Sugai...!
Now be a good boy and let Someya kill you.
What happened to you?
What happened, you ask?
You'll find out in the afterlife.
Now die!
You're not the one I'm after.
It's that sneering asshole behind you!
You'll die if you keep this up.
Just stop already!
I'm... not finished yet!
Oh dear, Kiryu.
You have no idea what you've done.
Kiyomi!

It seems we'll have to show Someya
the cost of failing our organization.
You took Kiyomi!?
Iwami!

I told Someya. If he managed to kill you,
I'd ensure his bitch got home safe.

Unfortunately for her,
Someya has failed to deliver on his promise.
Stop it...
Please...!

This would never have happened
if you had let Someya kill you.

Let her go, Iwami!
She isn't involved in this!
Why don't we trade?
I'll count to three.
And you... You are going to kill Someya.
If you do that, I'll let the girl go.
But I should be clear.
I am not known for my patience.

Fourth Chairman.
He's not messing around.
Kill me, I'm begging you!
Time's up.
No!
Th-The hell's goin' on here!?
Our daughter...

I never raised a hand to her...
Not even once...
I treated her like a princess.
Believe me...
What a tender moment.

That was a rather touching
display of familial love.
What are you doing!?
Well, he said time's up.
Y'know what that means.
This ain't happenin'!
Our daughter... Please...
I beg of you.

What're y'talkin' about!?
Yer gonna be fine!
We can still save ya!
Promise me.
Promise me... You'll take care of her.
I need to hear it.
She's gonna be jus' fine.
Y'can rest easy.
W-Wait, please...
I've waited long enough.
People are expecting you in hell.

You're nothing. Just a pathetic fool who
drags civilians into yakuza conflicts.
Do it, Sugai!

Kill the girl and the stupid kid!
End them!
Nagumo! Damn it!

Die!
Just die already!
Haruka... and Haruto...
Are they okay?
Yeah! They're just fine, Aniki!
Please take care of them, Yuta.
You can't die on us like this! Aniki!
Goddammit!
You'll pay fer what y'did to Kiryu-aniki.
So this is where the dream ends.

Get an ambulance down to the shipyard!
As fast as y'can!
I'm glad... you're safe... Haruka.
Don't look so satisfied about this!
You can't leave me, Uncle Kaz!
You can't give up!
Yuta... and Haruto...
Make them... happy.
Knowin' Kiyo-chan...
...I'm sure she was always thinkin' about ya.

Y'were jus' three when
y'got separated, right?
D'ya remember her?
Yer mom, I mean?
Only from pictures.
But... my dad always talked about her.
Someya did?
He said she didn't like his job.
That's why she had to leave him.
My dad...
He blamed himself for driving her away.
I getcha.
But still, y'can't be too sad.
Yer daddy raised ya up fine.
Still think it's crazy she made it out okay.
Was Koshimizu protectin' her or somethin'?

Seems the gun he had on Kiyomi-san
was loaded with blanks.

I mean, he had just watched
Someya kill himself to save her.
Musta made him consider a better way.

If we were livin' in a different world, maybe
he wouldn'ta gotten mixed up in all this.

He was probly sick o' bein' Iwami's lap dog.
Who wouldn't be, t'be honest?
Why he did it doesn't matter.
It's thanks to him that Kiyomi-san's still alive.
Y'gotta feel fer Cap, though.

His rival fer Kiyomi-san's heart
killed himself t'save her.
Ain't exactly a level he can compete on.

But fer now, he's gotta focus
on rebuildin' the Hirose Family.
You gotta help.
Y'can do it, Tagashira.
You too, Matsunaga-aniki.
Take care o' yerselves down in Okinawa, Yuta.
And you too, Haruto.
As fer Kiryu-aniki...
It's a damn shame.
I'm still havin' trouble processin' it.
He was a force to be reckoned with.
But for Haruto...

I think that when he gets bigger, he'll
remember the time he spent with Uncle Kaz.

I will too.
I could never forget him.
Uncle Kaz showed me so much warmth in life...

...And now, 
I have to do the same for him.
Ya must be tired just getting outta the slammer.
We've been waitin' for you, though.
You heard, didn't ya?

We're on the brink of war
with the Yomei Alliance.

Everyone's chompin' at the bit to
get revenge for the fourth chairman.
Ain't no halting that.
Can't say I disagree, though.
So what's yer plan?
Sixth Chairman.
Takeru Kurusu is dead.
His son Tsuneo is behind bars now.

And this Koshimizu guy has yet to take
full control of the Yomei Alliance.

So? You sayin' we strike Hiroshima
while the iron's hot?

Hiroshima's gonna expect us
to come knockin' sooner or later.
Sooner makes a shitton more sense to me.
I have a long list of regrets.

I have no business saying it, but,
I considered myself your father.

The things I should have told you over
the years have piled up like a mountain.

I failed you, though.
So much has been left unsaid.

In the past few weeks, I've seen so
many different kinds of relationships.
Different types of parents.
I saw a parent bound by customs.

Another who never loved his son...
and only realized after it was too late.
Children who, above all, wanted to prove themselves.

Show their parents they were capable.
Prove that they deserved their love.

So much grief came of it, the rift between
parent and child. I saw it firsthand.
Did these families have no faith in their bonds?
That wasn't it.
They had absolute faith in those bonds.

Even in this harsh reality, they tried to affirm
their bonds. Labored, agonized over them.
But... that wasn't the answer.

They simply didn't spend enough time together
as a family. And it ruined them.
If you ask me...
...Nothing is more vital than time.

To that end, I think we made
the same mistakes they did.

I never expected to become
the Tojo Clan's fourth chairman.

Then I tapped you to
become the sixth.

I considered you my son,
but I never thought to actually stand by your side.

It was easy to say I had faith in your judgment.
To say I entrusted everything to Daigo Dojima.
But that wasn't enough.

Instead of cherishing our time together,
I threw it all away. Rejected our bond.

Instead of facing my past, I ran.
And ran from you as well.
Thinking about the parents I've met...
I don't even have the words.

I don't have the right to call myself a
father to either you or the Tojo Clan.

So, by the time you read this letter,
I may already be gone.

But please, don't try to avenge me
as a son would his father.
My life isn't worth that much.
That is my final request of you.
My father has made a request of me.
I will honor his wishes.
We will not march on Hiroshima.

Instead, I will approach the Yomei Alliance
about a pact. One that sees us as equals.
Kiryu-chan, always thinkin' ten steps ahead.
This letter revealed something to me<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
Just how great a man my father was.
Guess ya did alright after all.
Fire!
Little Asia's up in flames!
I was scared outta my mind.
It felt kinda weird, though.
I'd just watched a man get murdered.

I was so afraid of seein' that again,
it didn't matter <font_kind=yakuza_italic>what</font_kind> the secret was.
But then...
To protect that secret...
...You became a murderer yourself.
It was jus' part of the job.
That ain't true, though...

When the boss bowed to me,
I felt important.
Important to Kurusu-san.
To Hiroshima.
To Japan.
I was just some little shit...

...But it felt like I had
the potential to be someone.
That was my driving force.
Never underestimate an idiot!
But y'already know that.
Or maybe not?

Hirose has been exemplary.
He carried out my orders without fail.

His beloved aniki,
leaders of the Yomei Alliance...
